Big refresh on the Node Tool

So I've decided that I'm going to be working on this tool long term :) During my thesis work I really thought this tool was onto something and it genuinely feels like a cumulation of all these years that I've been making programming environments .

I also recently started working as a graphic designer at Frontier and have been using the node tool in some capacity, and it has been a lot of fun! The more I use it the more I figure out what kind of user experience I want and what purpose this tool is serving. More on that later... But till then I just wanted to share some interface updates :V

This is from like October I would say. Just set the node tool back up, did some migrations, fixed up some bugs and made it more robust and extensible

And then I gave it a big design refresh, and have to give my thanks to Omama, she lowkey art-directed this design refresh.

this is the skin I'm using currently... I just like the barebones basic aesthetic :)
